evidence_note: Project names, scope and code links checked against public GitHub and Nitro source READMEs on 2026-11-19. Published source code does not imply a finished consumer product. Never expose machine addresses, customer data or private worktrees.

projects.title: SWAAG
projects.purpose: An AI agent that can carry out computer tasks instead of only answering questions.
projects.workflow: Give the assistant a request. Its controller can choose tools and specialized workers, track the task, and return results.
projects.benefit: Explore automating multi-step tasks while keeping control of tools and local infrastructure.
projects.limits: An actively developed framework, not a finished hands-off consumer assistant.

projects.title: all2text
projects.audience: Developers preparing mixed file collections for analysis
projects.purpose: Convert folders of different file types into auditable plain-text outputs.
projects.workflow: Point the tool at a folder. It mirrors the directory structure and produces text files and a conversion manifest.
projects.benefit: Prepare material for search, migration audits, or AI ingestion without losing track of which formats were unsupported.
projects.limits: Some formats require optional converters; it records limitations rather than inventing extracted content.

projects.title: Voice Button
projects.audience: People recording long voice notes on an Android phone
projects.purpose: Record, pause, resume, play back and transfer long recordings to a server.
projects.workflow: Record on the phone. Durable audio chunks can be synchronized and transcribed separately from recording.
projects.benefit: Reduce the risk of losing completed audio when recording or network transfers are interrupted.
projects.limits: Still in active device and reliability testing; not advertised as a Play Store release.

projects.title: KontextTastatur
projects.status: Working prototype · source not yet public
projects.audience: Android users who want personalized word suggestions
projects.purpose: A German-English keyboard that learns from words the user confirms.
projects.workflow: Type normally, choose a suggested word or phrase, and let local word-frequency history influence later suggestions.
projects.benefit: Explore more relevant suggestions while keeping personal typing history on the device.
projects.limits: Current implementation lives in a development worktree. It is not in the public Android repo or a verified Play Store release.

projects.title: Unity Game Systems
projects.status: Public package source · QA in progress
projects.audience: Unity developers assembling games and editor workflows
projects.purpose: Reusable Unity modules for interactions, inventory, saving and related game mechanics.
projects.workflow: Add the relevant package to a Unity project instead of implementing every common subsystem from scratch.
projects.benefit: A reusable starting point for building consistent game features across multiple projects.
projects.limits: The source and demo scenes are public; marketplace buyer-readiness is still under validation.

projects.title: Typewriter
projects.purpose: A browser-based typing trainer with drills, text practice and a repeatable sequence challenge.
projects.workflow: Practice current keys, measure accuracy and speed, and compare results with previous rounds.
projects.benefit: Target weaker keys and see measurable improvement without needing an account.
projects.limits: It runs locally from a web server; no hosted public game or store release is claimed.

projects.title: Android Voice Client
projects.audience: Developers integrating phone audio with a self-hosted agent
projects.purpose: Explore two-way voice conversations between an Android client and a local AI service.
projects.workflow: A prototype records and streams speech while receiving voice responses from a connected server.
projects.benefit: Investigate hands-free access to locally hosted AI from a phone.
projects.limits: A technical prototype requiring server configuration, not an independently released phone assistant.

projects.title: Image Analysis Toolkit
projects.purpose: Classify and organize images using pretrained machine-learning models.
projects.workflow: Run a local analysis script over images or a folder and inspect the resulting labels.
projects.benefit: Explore automating parts of image categorization and review.
projects.limits: Research utilities, not a validated production image-management application.

projects.title: KnowMoreNewsClips Workflow
projects.audience: Creators processing longer recordings into short clips
projects.purpose: Software-assisted selection, transcription, editing and preparation of short news clips.
projects.workflow: Work with source footage, complete spoken passages, subtitles and publication-ready clip packages.
projects.benefit: Reduce repeated editorial and media-processing steps while retaining source traceability.
projects.limits: This is an internal production workflow. Source code is not publicly linked or offered as a software product.
